lessons.title: SLA Breach Renewal Guardrail
lessons.rule: No renewal with 2+ SLA breaches without a service-credit clause and a 90-day exit.
lessons.action_required: Must escalate to senior. Require mandatory 5% service credit per breach, 90-day termination for convenience, and at least one competing benchmark quote.

lessons.title: Price Hike Benchmark Guardrail
lessons.rule: No price increase above 8% without a competing quote and market benchmark review.
lessons.action_required: Escalate to senior. Refuse auto-indexing without independent market benchmarking and formal supplier negotiation.

lessons.title: Client Data Governance & Residency Guardrail
lessons.rule: Any vendor handling client data requires verified data location, DPA signed, approved sub-processor list, and 24h breach notice.
lessons.trigger: vendor_onboarding or vendor_renewal with handles_client_data == true
lessons.action_required: Escalate immediately with data security checklist: verify in-country residency, execute formal DPA, prohibit unvetted sub-processors, and mandate 24-hour incident notification.

lessons.title: Fully-Loaded One-Time Spend Guardrail
lessons.rule: One-time service and fitout quotes require fully-loaded cost breakdown; no open-ended consumables or reimbursables.
lessons.action_required: Reject or escalate until quote provides fixed cap on consumables and itemized bill of materials.

lessons.title: Key Personnel Verification Guardrail
lessons.rule: For service/staffing vendors with named key personnel, verify named persons are active and contractually bound before renewal.
lessons.action_required: Verify named lead presence before approval; insert substitution approval clause with 30-day handover period.

lessons.title: Early-Stage Vendor Advance Payment Cap
lessons.rule: Advance payment capped at 30% for vendors with less than 24 months relationship history.
lessons.trigger: any request with advance_pct > 30 and relationship_months < 24
lessons.action_required: Escalate to senior. Refuse commercial terms requiring >30% advance without bank guarantee or escrow milestone.
